about_the_game:
Step into the shattered mind of a man haunted by his past in this chilling psychological horror puzzle game. Return to the eerie, riddled manor where you once lived with your wife and daughter, a place steeped in tragedy and shadowed by accusations. Imprisoned for a murder you can’t recall committing, you’re drawn back to uncover the truth, battling the relentless grip of schizophrenia that twists your reality with every step.

Navigate a series of mind-bending puzzles that test not just your wits, but your sanity. As your mental health unravels, the world around you distorts, whispers echo in the dark, visions blur your sight, and nightmares seep into reality. Scavenge for meds to hold the madness at bay, but time is your enemy, and every moment pushes you closer to the edge.

With each puzzle you conquer, uncover heartfelt letters from your daughter, addressed to you, piecing together the heartbreaking story of your family’s collapse. Search the manor’s forgotten corners for hidden artifacts that reveal its sinister secrets and the fractured memories you’ve buried deep.

When the schizophrenia overwhelms you, dare to "recenter" your mind, a desperate mechanic that resets your sanity but forces you to restart the puzzle from scratch. It’s a haunting trade-off: sacrifice progress to cling to clarity, or press on as the line between truth and hallucination fades.

As you descend deeper into the manor’s depths, brace yourself for a devastating revelation, your daughter’s tragic fate, tied to her mother’s grave, and a final twist that will shatter everything you thought you knew. This is a journey of guilt, grief, and discovery where every answer comes at a cost.

Other Key Features:

  • Hidden Artifacts: Search every dark corner of the eerie manor to find optional historic artifacts that were left behind after the family's tragic collapse. Collect them all!

  • An Immersive Experience: Step into the haunting depths of an abandoned manor, a sprawling, meticulously crafted world brimming with secrets. Explore corridors and hidden rooms, solving intricate puzzles to uncover letters and artifacts that breathe life into the manor’s mysterious past. Every discovery pulls you deeper into a narrative woven through the environment, rewarding your curiosity with a rich, unfolding story.

  • Interactions: There is no combat, instead Insanity Within thrives on a simple interaction system. Pull rusty levers, shift towering statues, connect celestial constellations, and inspect eerie decor to unlock the manor’s secrets. Medicine offers a lifeline, letting you pause or restore your sanity, but use it wisely. This variety of interactions keeps gameplay dynamic and reinforces the focus on exploration and mental mastery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 (3.2 GHz, 4 cores) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2 GHz, 4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 (4 GB VRAM) or AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 (3.0 GHz, 8 cores) or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (3.7 GHz, 6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (6 GB VRAM) or AMD RX 6600 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: A psychological horror game with a twist... Solve a variety of puzzles in a riddled manor as schizophrenia distorts your reality. When you've gone insane, recenter your mind at the cost of your progress. Uncover the letters left to you, to reveal the haunting truth you never knew.
